# cloudsmith_api_key_rule (Resource)

The API key rule resource manages the maximum permitted age of API keys in a Cloudsmith organization. Each rule applies to either user accounts or service accounts. Requests using an API key older than `max_age_hours` are rejected, and keys can optionally be rotated automatically once they exceed it.

See [docs.cloudsmith.com](https://docs.cloudsmith.com/workspaces/api-key-rules) for the full API key rules documentation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_organization" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}

# User accounts: keys stop working after 90 days until the user rotates them.
resource "cloudsmith_api_key_rule" "users" {
  organization  = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  rule_type     = "User Accounts"
  max_age_hours = 2160
  is_enabled    = true
}

# Service accounts: keys older than 90 days are rotated automatically.
resource "cloudsmith_api_key_rule" "service_accounts" {
  organization    = data.cloudsmith_organization.my_organization.slug_perm
  rule_type       = "Service Accounts"
  max_age_hours   = 2160
  is_enabled      = true
  enforce_refresh = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization to which this rule belongs.
- `rule_type` (String) The account types this rule applies to. One of: 'Service Accounts', 'User Accounts'.

### Optional

- `enforce_refresh` (Boolean) Whether API keys that exceed `max_age_hours` are rotated automatically. Rotation is irreversible: anything using an old key must be updated with the new one. Collaborators are never rotated. When omitted, the current setting is left unchanged; set it to `false` to turn automatic rotation off.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rule is currently active and enforced.
- `max_age_hours` (Number) The maximum permitted age of an API key, in hours. API keys older than this lose access until rotated. Omit to disable the age limit.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the rule was created at.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_applied_at` (String) The last time this rule was evaluated and applied by the expiry task.
- `slug` (String) Human-readable identifier, generated from the rule type.
- `slug_perm` (String) An auto-generated id that uniquely identifies the rule.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the rule was last updated at.
